brand.source_quote: Glow Labs Ltd, trading as Glow Serum ("Brand")

fee.source_quote: a total fee of £2,500 (two thousand five hundred pounds sterling)

payment_terms.source_quote: within ninety (90) days of Brand's receipt of a valid invoice

deliverables.source_quote: one (1) TikTok video of 30 to 60 seconds, to be posted no later than 20 March 2026

usage_rights.duration_text: twelve (12) months from the Effective Date
usage_rights.source_quote: Brand may repost the deliverables on Brand's own social media channels (TikTok and Instagram) for twelve (12) months from the Effective Date
Brand may use the deliverables in paid advertising on all platforms, worldwide, in perpetuity

whitelisting.duration_text: 90 days from the date the first deliverable is posted
whitelisting.source_quote: for ninety (90) days from the date the first deliverable is posted

exclusivity.duration_text: from the Effective Date until 31 December 2026
exclusivity.source_quote: Creator will not create sponsored content for any other skincare brand, including but not limited to The Ordinary, CeraVe and La Roche-Posay, from the Effective Date until 31 December 2026

revision_rounds.source_quote: Creator will make all revisions requested by Brand until Brand approves the content

raw_file_delivery.source_quote: Creator will deliver the raw, unedited footage for each deliverable to Brand within 5 business days of posting

termination.source_quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement with 14 days' written notice

kill_fee.value: 50% of the total fee if Brand terminates after production begins
kill_fee.source_quote: Brand will pay Creator a kill fee of 50% of the total fee

red_flags.quote: including content created or edited using artificial intelligence tools
red_flags.why: The brand could make new content of you with AI, beyond what you filmed.

red_flags.quote: deliver the raw, unedited footage for each deliverable
red_flags.why: Raw footage lets the brand re-cut your content in ways you haven't approved.
